about.title: Attribution and licence
about.lead: The temporal-bone page targets the ZETA specimen from the OpenEar library. The meshes and CT currently in this repository are not that dataset.
about.openearBody: Human temporal-bone models published by Sieber et al. in Scientific Data (2018). The paper and the Zenodo data are CC BY 4.0. When the real files are added, attribution, a change notice, and the licence link must stay on this page and in the footer.
about.obligation1: Credit Sieber et al., the OpenEar library, Sci Data 2018.
about.obligation2: Say if you changed the material. The sample geometry is already marked as not the original.
about.obligation3: Keep the licence name and link (CC BY 4.0).
about.sampleBody: The glb files and slice PNGs under public/temporal-bone are placeholders so the viewer runs. They are laid out in millimetre-like coordinates at scale 1, but they are not OpenEar measurements. Every text status is unverified.
about.vorBody: Z-Anatomy assets planned for the VOR page are CC BY-SA. Share-alike means derivatives that include those assets must be shared under the same terms, with attribution. Keep OpenEar (CC BY) credit separate from Z-Anatomy credit.
about.reviewBody: There are two badges. 미검증 means not yet checked. YS 검수 완료 means the review is done. When geometry changes, bump model_version and set the related copy back to 미검증.
vor.title: Vestibulo-ocular reflex (VOR)

vor.licenceNote: The planned Z-Anatomy assets are CC BY-SA. Reuse requires attribution and share-alike.
